1.7.7Ibn-ul-Haitham
He lived in 965 - 1039 AD and was one of the most outstanding biologists of Muslim
word.Basicallyhewas an ophthalmologist.He corrected the Greek concept of vision
locating retina as the seat of vision. His famous books" Kitabul Manazir" and " Mizanul
Hikma" were translated into Latin, Hebrew, Greek and other western languages.
1.7.8Ali Bin Isa
He was a well-known eye specialist. He worked on the structure, function and
diseases of the eye. He described 130 diseases of the eye in his book. The book was
translated into many European languages.
1.7.9 Ibn-ul-Nafees
He was a renowned biologist of 13t century A.D. He described the circulation of blood
in human body.
